# Chris Dunaetz

> Senior software engineer who makes demanding workloads run fast on real hardware: real-time 3D, stereoscopic video and on-device AI, taken from prototype to launch on Apple Vision Pro and Meta Quest at The Walt Disney Company (2019-present). iOS developer since 2015. Looking to bring GPU and parallel-compute experience to AI. Based in the Los Angeles area; open to remote or hybrid roles in Southern California.

## Links

- [Website](https://chrisdunaetz.github.io/)
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/chrisdunaetz)

## Technical highlights (Disney)

- 96 FPS on Meta Quest 3 rendering a 3D environment around a 4K stereo film at 48 FPS, on an XR2 Gen 2 that also runs tracking and passthrough, with about half the peak GPU compute of Vision Pro's M2.
- Under 200 ms from tap to first frame on average for 800 MB environments on Vision Pro, using GPU-ready ASTC/KTX textures, front-half-first loading and deferred custom-shader compilation.
- The Alien: Earth environment runs dynamic lighting, shadows, skeletal animation, particle simulation, vertex-displacement shaders, anisotropic reflections and volumetric lighting at the same time.
- Foveated Gaussian splatting: moved a Metal splat renderer onto RealityKit through LowLevelMesh to gain foveated rendering and hybrid rendering with traditional meshes.
- On-device AI: real-time semantic segmentation with custom PyTorch models on Core ML, composited with the live camera feed in custom Metal shaders.

## Projects (Disney)

- Disney+ immersive viewing environments: led the effort to bring ILM-built 3D worlds into Disney+ as immersive viewing environments, announced in Apple's WWDC 2023 keynote and live on Vision Pro's launch day; primary engineer on the RealityKit runtime.
- Alien: Earth on Vision Pro: brought FX's Alien: Earth environment to Vision Pro with little project structure; got the outside vendor's models and animation running in headset and hand-authored the dynamic lighting, particles and some of the sound. Featured by Apple in a 2025 Meet with Apple session.
- Meta Quest port: ported the environments to Meta Quest in the new Meta Spatial SDK; rewrote surface and vertex shaders, kept color accurate between Vision Pro's P3 displays and Quest, and built the test-bench app used to debug them for Quest and future Meta hardware.
- Built a 180-degree stereo video format ahead of Apple Immersive Video; rendered, encoded and shipped films in it.
- Wrote Swift tooling to encode MV-HEVC and Apple Immersive Video on Apple silicon's hardware encoder (VideoToolbox), and streamed Apple Immersive Video over HLS. Used NVIDIA hardware encoders (NVENC) to cut bitrate for other experiences.
- Built a Vision Pro flight-sim test bench measuring which motions feel fun versus cause motion sickness.
- Built the SwiftUI App Clip for Marvel's Eternals AR companion app.

- Phunware, iOS Developer (2017-2019): led features and the largest UI overhaul for the FOXNOW, FXNOW and Nat Geo TV streaming apps (15M users).
- Krue, Hairdoo and other startups, iOS Developer (2015-2017).

- USD Summit, Pixar headquarters (2025): delivering Vision Pro runtime assets via USD in RealityKit.
